merge.visual: Two diagonal lines converging upward into a single arrow, representing two paths joining into one.

replace.visual: A small square with a curved arrow moving it into a new position, with a dotted outline marking the original location.
usage: Swapping a file or asset in place

vote.visual: A laptop with a large checkmark displayed on its screen.

chart-gantt.visual: Horizontal bars of varying lengths aligned to a left axis, each row shorter than the one above.

table-cells-merge.visual: A grid with two equal cells in the top row and one wide cell spanning the full width of the bottom row.
usage: Merging table cells in a spreadsheet

table-cells-split.visual: A grid with two equal cells in the top row and one wide cell spanning the full width of the bottom row.

newspaper.visual: A document page with a smaller overlapping page in the lower-left corner and two horizontal text lines.

vault.visual: A rounded square containing a central circle connected by lines to each corner, resembling a crosshair or locking mechanism.

server-crash.visual: A rounded rectangle with a dashed border, a lightning bolt in the center, and two dots on either side.

bring-to-front.visual: A smaller rounded square positioned in the upper-left overlapping a larger rounded square behind it.

send-to-back.visual: A large rounded square in the upper-left with a smaller rounded square overlapping it in the lower-right corner.
usage: Sending a layer behind others in design tools

wifi-high.visual: Two concentric arcs above a central dot, representing a wireless signal.

file-archive.visual: A document icon with a vertical dotted line running down its center and a small circle at the bottom, like a zipper.

banknote.visual: A wide rounded rectangle with a circle in the center flanked by two small dots, resembling a bill or payment card.

coins.visual: Two circular coin icons overlapping with a curved double-headed arrow between them, suggesting exchange.

picture-in-picture.visual: A large rectangle outline with a small filled rectangle and an inward arrow in the lower-left corner.

separator-horizontal.visual: A horizontal line in the center with an upward chevron above it and a downward chevron below it.

flip-horizontal.visual: Two facing bracket shapes with a vertical dashed line between them, representing a mirror axis.
usage: Flipping an image or shape horizontally

sticky-note.visual: A plain square with a folded corner in the upper-right, like a document page or note.
